3.speaker: Narrator
3.text: A few weeks had passed since the attack in Zille.

4.speaker: Narrator
4.text: I called Lucita, Hugo, Titus and Vina to my council chambers for a security update.

8.speaker: Narrator
8.text: I called Lucita, Hugo and Titus to my council chambers for a security update.

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: Titus insisted on sweeping the room before Vina and I sat down. Hugo was next to arrive, early as usual.

10.speaker: Narrator
10.text: Titus insisted on sweeping the room before I sat down. Hugo was next to arrive, early as usual.

12.speaker: Player_Romus
12.text: "I'm still in shock. How was such an attack allowed to take place in the King's presence?"

13.speaker: Player_Romus
13.text: "I'm just fine. It's the Wehzek victims of the bombing I'm concerned about."

14.speaker: Player_Romus
14.text: "I'm doing all right. So is Mother, in case you cared."

15.speaker: Player_Romus
15.text: "I'm worried about Wehlen's reaction. Smolak hasn't even made a public statement yet."

16.speaker: Hugo Toras
16.text: "Perhaps no news is good news in this case."

17.speaker: Hugo Toras
17.text: "I can only hope Duchess Azaro will enlighten us on that matter."

18.speaker: Hugo Toras
18.text: "It was God's will that you survived. Losing two kings within a year would have been catastrophic for this country."

19.speaker: Hugo Toras
19.text: "Of course the Queen Mother's safety is of the utmost importance to me. But losing two kings in a matter of months would have been catastrophic."

22.speaker: Player_Romus
22.text: "We're not all gentlemen. Do not forget the presence of the princess."

23.speaker: Player_Romus
23.text: "Thank you for joining us, Duchess Azaro. Can you update us on the Zille situation?"

26.speaker: Narrator
26.text: Lucita sat and flipped open a dossier.

27.speaker: Narrator
27.text: Still standing, she picked a dossier up off the table and flipped it open.

29.speaker: Lucita Azaro
29.text: "At 1605 hours on December 8, 1950, an explosive object detonated in Smolak Square in the city of Zille. It had been planted beneath grandstands that were set up that morning."

30.speaker: Lucita Azaro
30.text: "Seated in those stands were a mix of civilians and political figures who had been invited to the Friendship Day event, all of Wehzek heritage."

31.speaker: Lucita Azaro
31.text: "The most recent casualty report states that three civilians were killed in the blast. Of the 14 injured, all are now in stable condition."

32.speaker: Player_Romus
32.text: "Don't forget that right before the attack, someone screamed 'For the King.'"

33.speaker: Player_Romus
33.text: "Yes, yes, we know all that. What's new?"

35.speaker: Player_Romus
35.text: "Thank God. From what I saw, it could have been much worse."

36.speaker: Lucita Azaro
36.text: "No, the most prominent Wehzek attendees all made it out unharmed. Wehlen's guards saw to that."

41.speaker: Lucita Azaro
41.text: "Based on the scant evidence available, Wehlen's intelligence agency suspects that the Rizian nationalist group Su Omina was behind the crime."

42.speaker: Vina Toras
42.text: "I don't understand why Cousin Rico would even support a group like that."

46.speaker: Player_Romus
46.text: "I appreciate the boy's efforts. But I wish he would coordinate them with me."

47.speaker: Player_Romus
47.text: "It's true. National identity should be secondary to one's loyalty to the throne."

48.speaker: Player_Romus
48.text: "That's rubbish. The monarchy and the nation of Rizia cannot be separated from one another. I appreciate Rico's efforts to protect both."

50.speaker: Player_Romus
50.text: "Yes, Rico has no right using the Toras name to serve his own xenophobic agenda."

51.speaker: Lucita Azaro
51.text: "If I may, Your Grace, why have you never once thrown your own weight behind Su Omina if you support its ideals?"

52.speaker: Lucita Azaro
52.text: "Agreed, Let's get back to the topic at hand. Although..."

53.speaker: Lucita Azaro
53.text: "Future or not, we have no concrete proof Su Omina was behind the attack. All we have is Wehlen's word."

54.speaker: Player_Romus
54.text: "Then what are your foreign intelligence agents good for? They didn't even predict this would happen!"

55.speaker: Player_Romus
55.text: "And it's in Wehlen's interest to pin the blame for the bombing on Rizia."

56.speaker: Player_Romus
56.text: "Rico has no right using the Toras name to support a xenophobic agenda."

57.speaker: Player_Romus
57.text: "I know the way these groups function. It's only a short leap from talk to bloodshed."

58.speaker: Player_Romus
58.text: "Without them, Wehlen's criminals would be running roughshod all over our country."

59.speaker: Player_Romus
59.text: "What more do we need? It seems like a cut-and-dried case to me."

60.speaker: Hugo Toras
60.text: "That's part of the reason why I've been asking you to visit Iza. Obviously the King should be kept abreast of the group's activities."

61.speaker: Hugo Toras
61.text: "Surely you don't truly feel that way, or you wouldn't have lent your support to the group."

62.speaker: Narrator
62.text: He smiled warmly at Vina. My daughter looked away.

63.speaker: Hugo Toras
63.text: "My son is as much of a Toras as you or Princess Vina. And frankly, he should be commended for his efforts to protect the country from miscreants."

64.speaker: Hugo Toras
64.text: "Do you really think the Wehzek miscreants streaming into this country are doing so out of loyalty to you?"

65.speaker: Lucita Azaro
65.text: "They've been doing the best they can with their limited resources."

66.speaker: Lucita Azaro
66.text: "Exactly. We still haven't ruled out the possibility that President Smolak himself ordered it."

67.speaker: Hugo Toras
67.text: "Have you not considered the possibility that the attack was staged by Wehlen itself? Or another party interested in weakening both of us?"

68.speaker: Hugo Toras
68.text: "Or another party interested in weakening the both of us."

69.speaker: Player_Romus
69.text: "Why have we not looked into this ourselves?"

70.speaker: Lucita Azaro
70.text: "With an increased foreign intelligence budget, we could commission a full investigation into the Zille incident and take measures to prevent such an event from reoccurring."

71.speaker: Lucita Azaro
71.text: "Our foreign intelligence agency is hamstrung by its limited resources, Your Majesty."

73.speaker: Narrator
73.text: All eyes turned towards the man in the gold blazer.

74.speaker: Titus Gordion
74.text: "May I point out that you weren't present on the day of the Zille incident. The King and I were."

75.speaker: Titus Gordion
75.text: "Prior to His Majesty's arrival, my men and I attempted to clear the square of every conceivable danger. However, we could not be everywhere at once."

77.speaker: Player_Romus
77.text: "You missed a bomb. That counts as a massive lapse on the Golden Guard's part."

78.speaker: Player_Romus
78.text: "You helped save our lives back there. No need to make excuses."

79.speaker: Player_Romus
79.text: "It shouldn't have been your job to find the bomb. It was Wehlen's."

80.speaker: Titus Gordion
80.text: "It shouldn't have even come to that point."

81.speaker: Titus Gordion
81.text: "Our job is to take every measure to protect the King of Rizia. In that respect, we failed."

82.speaker: Titus Gordion
82.text: "Our job is to take every measure to protect the King of Rizia. In that respect, we failed."

83.speaker: Titus Gordion
83.text: "This event has shown how vulnerable you and the royal family truly are, and how ill-equipped my men and I are to seek out and neutralize threats to your safety."

84.speaker: Titus Gordion
84.text: "Therefore, it is my opinion that any emergency funding allocated in the wake of the Zille attack should go towards re-expanding the Golden Guard."

85.speaker: Narrator
85.text: Lucita's jaw dropped. Hugo eyed Titus uneasily.

86.speaker: Titus Gordion
86.text: "Ma'am, it's important to recognize the historical significance of the Golden Guard. Until quite recently, our role extended far beyond mere guardians of the King."

87.speaker: Titus Gordion
87.text: "Previously, the Guard had the authority to conduct sensitive internal investigations without getting caught up in red tape. The Royal Family and Rizia were both more secure because of it."

88.speaker: Player_Romus
88.text: "Good point. Before giving more funding to foreign intelligence, I need to make sure I'm safe within my own borders."

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "What kind of investigations did you have in mind, Captain?"

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "Can you not make more efficient use of the funding you already have. Captain?"

91.speaker: Player_Romus
91.text: "We need to find out who's behind this bombing. Can the Golden Guard help with that?"

92.speaker: Titus Gordion
92.text: "That's precisely what I'm suggesting. We need to recruit qualified individuals and equip them with the technology to carry out covert surveillance in Iza--"

93.speaker: Titus Gordion
93.text: "Your Majesty, given the resources, we could recruit a number of qualified individuals and equip them with the technology to carry out covert surveillance in Iza--"

94.speaker: Titus Gordion
94.text: "The type of investigation I'm proposing would require more, sir. We need to recruit qualified individuals and equip them with the technology to carry out covert surveillance in Iza--"

95.speaker: Titus Gordion
95.text: "With respect, sir, we don't know whether it's a dead end. And investigating an organization with ties to the royal family is exactly the kind of sensitive mission the Golden Guard was built for."

96.speaker: Narrator
96.text: She, Hugo and Titus glared at each other.

97.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
97.text: "Excuse me, Your Majesty. My fellow councilors. These stairs never get easier."

99.speaker: Narrator
99.text: The tension was broken by a knock on the door. Laurento came in, clearly out of breath.

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "Don't interrupt us. We're in the middle of an important security briefing."

102.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
102.text: "I understand, Your Majesty. But you're going to want to hear this."

103.speaker: Narrator
103.text: Laurento sat down. After catching his breath, he continued.

104.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
104.text: "I've just received word from Wehlen's foreign minister. President Smolak plans to make it public that Rizian nationalists were involved in the Zille incident."

106.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
106.text: "Furthermore, given the contents of the King's speech just prior to the attack, chances are that King Romus himself will come under fire for inciting the violence."

111.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
111.text: "I did advise you to maintain an air of civility, Your Majesty."

112.speaker: Player_Romus
112.text: "Past is past. We have to focus on what we're going to do next."

113.speaker: Player_Romus
113.text: "Do not question my decisions, Mr. Esquibel."

114.speaker: Player_Romus
114.text: "I didn't incite anything. I merely told the truth."

115.speaker: Player_Romus
115.text: "I'm sorry. I must have gotten carried away."

116.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
116.text: "Our relations with Wehlen have been cordial enough that Smolak will not immediately blame the crown. But he will be expecting a response."

117.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
117.text: "My sincerest apologies. Let's focus on how we're going to respond."

118.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
118.text: "Correct. Wehlen will be expecting a response from us."

119.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
119.text: "On their own, your words might not have been considered incendiary. But their timing was most unfortunate."

120.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
120.text: "What's done is done. But now Wehlen will be expecting a response from us."

121.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
121.text: "Wehlen will be expecting a response from us."

122.speaker: Lucita Azaro
122.text: "He's just testing us. His government can't prove anything."

123.speaker: Lucita Azaro
123.text: "Smolak is just testing us. His government can't prove anything."

124.speaker: Hugo Toras
124.text: "Still, an apology for your harsh language would be in order so as not to inflame relations further."

125.speaker: Player_Romus
125.text: "How dare he insult us with these baseless accusations?"

126.speaker: Player_Romus
126.text: "An apology won't be enough. I have to point the finger somewhere."

127.speaker: Player_Romus
127.text: "This makes me certain that Wehlen was behind the bombing. They're trying to weaken our claim on Zille."

128.speaker: Player_Romus
128.text: "Lack of proof never stopped Wehlen from waging war on the Bluds. The Wehzeks are irrational."

129.speaker: Player_Romus
129.text: "I'll do whatever I have to do to get President Smolak back on our side."

130.speaker: Lucita Azaro
130.text: "That's dangerous, Your Majesty. If we begin offering concessions, there are no limits to what Wehlen will demand."

131.speaker: Lucita Azaro
131.text: "You see now why I want to launch an investigation? Imagine the reaction once it comes out that Smolak attacked his own people."

132.speaker: Hugo Toras
132.text: "Yes, I can't imagine any response that would pacify that man."

133.speaker: Player_Romus
133.text: "I understand the need to apologize. What I won't do is blame my own people for what happened."

134.speaker: Player_Romus
134.text: "An apology would be an admission of guilt. I can't do that."

135.speaker: Player_Romus
135.text: "I'll do whatever I have to do to get the President back on our side."

136.speaker: Lucita Azaro
136.text: "That's right. If we let Smolak believe we have something to apologize for, there are no limits to what he'll demand."

137.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
137.text: "People are dead, Your Majesty. Someone must take the blame."

138.speaker: Lucita Azaro
138.text: "That's dangerous, Your Majesty. If we begin offering concessions, there are no limits to what Wehlen will demand."

139.speaker: Hugo Toras
139.text: "Quite right. There's no need to throw Rico to the Wehzek wolves."

140.speaker: Lucita Azaro
140.text: "Then point it right back at Wehlen. Launch an investigation. Call Smolak's bluff."

141.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
141.text: "May I ask what the five of you were discussing before I came in?"

145.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
145.text: "May I ask what the four of you were discussing before I came in?"

146.speaker: Hugo Toras
146.text: "A question of priorities. Duchess Azaro is requesting funding for a foreign intelligence expansion in order to investigate the Zille incident. Mr. Gordion would rather his Golden Guard be enlarged and given license to conduct its own investigations within Rizia's borders."

147.speaker: Vina Toras
147.text: "Our security response to the Zille incident. Duchess Azaro is requesting funds for an expansion of foreign intelligence to conduct an investigation in Wehlen, while Captain Gordion would prefer the Golden Guard be expanded and given license to investigate threats within Rizia's borders."

149.speaker: Player_Romus
149.text: "Actually, taking up Titus' offer to conduct a thorough investigation of Su Omina could help pacify Wehlen."

150.speaker: Player_Romus
150.text: "If I fund Duchess Azaro's investigation and it exposes Wehzek wrongdoing, Smolak won't have a leg to stand on."

151.speaker: Hugo Toras
151.text: "At the expense of Rico's dignity, and thus the dignity of House Toras."

152.speaker: Titus Gordion
152.text: "Rest assured that if the Duke of Iza has nothing to hide, his dignity will remain intact."

153.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
153.text: "A tricky needle to thread, Your Majesty. Pursuing such an investigation might lead the President to think you're undermining his authority."

156.speaker: Narrator
156.text: Laurento raised an eyebrow at Titus, pleasantly surprised.

157.speaker: Player_Romus
157.text: "To be honest, I'd rather not waste our budget on either of those."

160.speaker: Lucita Azaro
160.text: "A significant portion of our emergency funds. But it'll be worth it."

161.speaker: Player_Romus
161.text: "And what if it turns out Rizian nationalists were responsible after all?"

162.speaker: Lucita Azaro
162.text: "Then they'll be found and dealt with."

163.speaker: Player_Romus
163.text: "More budget demands? This country is not made of money, Duchess Azaro."

164.speaker: Lucita Azaro
164.text: "If the truth is not revealed, it will cost us even more dearly."

165.speaker: Player_Romus
165.text: "Sounds like a good idea to me."

166.speaker: Lucita Azaro
166.text: "Then you have better judgement than your father did."

167.speaker: Lucita Azaro
167.text: "For once we agree, Captain. Going along with Wehlen's accusations without even trying to gather our own evidence would only give Smolak ammunition."

168.speaker: Lucita Azaro
168.text: "If Wehlen has nothing to hide, they will welcome our assistance."

169.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
169.text: "Showing Wehlen that you are serious about investigating the potential terrorists makes diplomatic sense."

170.speaker: Lucita Azaro
170.text: "Let's not forget His Majesty has a personal history with the organization. Uncovering any unsavory information could harm the throne."

174.speaker: Lucita Azaro
174.text: "I agree it's dangerous to investigate an organization that His Majesty has blood ties to."

175.speaker: Titus Gordion
175.text: "But officially clearing Su Omina's name would be a boon for both the group and the Kingdom."

176.speaker: Hugo Toras
176.text: "Sending investigators to Zille would also shift the focus away from Su Omina and the royal family."

177.speaker: Hugo Toras
177.text: "My pleasure. His Majesty already knows which course of action I'd prefer."

178.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
178.text: "Interesting initiative, Mr. Gordion. Following up on Wehlen's leads with our own internal investigation would certainly make diplomatic sense."

179.speaker: Titus Gordion
179.text: "Precisely. If it were up to me, I would recruit a number of qualified individuals and equip them with the technology to carry out covert surveillance in Iza--"

180.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
180.text: "So, Your Majesty. Will the Crown be funding one of these proposed expansions?"

181.speaker: Player_Romus
181.text: "Let's go with Lucita's proposal. Expand our intelligence force and send a team of investigators to Wehlen." [-4 Budget]

182.speaker: Player_Romus
182.text: "Captain Gordion, I admire your initiative. I'll provide support to expand the Guard to a division-sized unit. With these extra resources, you'll conduct a full investigation into Su Omina's activities." [-4 Budget]

183.speaker: Player_Romus
183.text: "Sorry to disappoint you both, but I've decided not to fund either of your investigations."

184.speaker: Titus Gordion
184.text: "Thank you for your trust in the Golden Guard, sir. We won't fail you."

185.speaker: Lucita Azaro
185.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. I promise my department will get results."

188.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
188.text: "It seems the next steps are quite clear, or was there any other subject that needed discussion?"

196.speaker: Lucita Azaro
196.text: "I'm quite satisfied with our results today."

197.speaker: Hugo Toras
197.text: "I'll see you out. I have nothing more to say."
197.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_RizianForeignIntelligence_Expanded"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true) == false)

198.speaker: Vina Toras
198.text: "I think that was everything, wasn't it, Your Majesty?"
198.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_GoldenGuard_Expanded"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Policy_Order_RizianForeignIntelligence_Expanded"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Vina_OnCouncil"] == true)

199.speaker: Player_Romus
199.text: "Yes, you're all dismissed. Enjoy the rest of your day."

200.speaker: Player_Romus
200.text: "We're done when I say we're done. But yes, we are done."

205.speaker: Narrator
205.text: The others began filing out of the room. Titus stayed behind.

206.speaker: Narrator
206.text: The others began filing out of the room. Lucita stayed behind.

213.speaker: Narrator
213.text: She took off her cap and looked me in the eyes.

214.speaker: Lucita Azaro
214.text: "Allow me to express my gratitude once more, Your Majesty. As a newcomer to this council, it means a lot that you would place your trust in me."

215.speaker: Titus Gordion
215.text: "Thank you once again, Your Majesty. You have the Golden Guard's undying loyalty."

216.speaker: Narrator
216.text: He walked up to me and looked me in the eyes.

217.speaker: Player_Romus
217.text: "I expect results, Duchess Azaro. Don't disappoint me."

218.speaker: Player_Romus
218.text: "Don't mention it. Your counsel is far more valuable than that of our doddering elders."

219.speaker: Player_Romus
219.text: "Now that you have the funding, I'd like your help with an investigation of a more sensitive nature." [Investigate Poisoning]

221.speaker: Lucita Azaro
221.text: "I would be honored. What is it?"

228.speaker: Narrator
228.text: She reached out and gave me a handshake. Her hand lingered in mine for just a second longer than normal before she withdrew it.

230.speaker: Narrator
230.text: She put her cap back on and hurriedly left the room.

231.speaker: Player_Romus
231.text: "You are the King's guard, Mr. Gordion. Your loyalty should not be contingent on funding."

232.speaker: Titus Gordion
232.text: "No. Of course not. I beg your pardon."

233.speaker: Player_Romus
233.text: "I expect results, Titus. Don't disappoint me."

237.speaker: Player_Romus
237.text: "Good. Because there's one other investigation I'd like you to conduct for me." [Investigate Poisoning]

238.speaker: Titus Gordion
238.text: "Is this in regard the murder investigation you previously alluded to?"

239.speaker: Player_Romus
239.text: "Yes. I'd like to know exactly how my father died."

240.speaker: Titus Gordion
240.text: "I swear on my life that I will not."

241.speaker: Player_Romus
241.text: "You already demonstrated that loyalty back in Zille. This is the least I can do for you."

242.speaker: Player_Romus
242.text: "Precisely. It's imperative that I receive any and all information surrounding the circumstances of my father's death."

243.speaker: Narrator
243.text: Titus eyes grew wide. He lowered the volume of his voice so that only I could hear.

244.speaker: Titus Gordion
244.text: "I was also there that night, as you already know. Like you, I too find the circumstances suspicious."

245.speaker: Narrator
245.text: Titus froze in place. He spoke in a low voice.

246.speaker: Titus Gordion
246.text: "Again, I was only fulfilling my duty. But much appreciated."

247.speaker: Narrator
247.text: Titus gave a dutiful bow and left the room.

248.speaker: Titus Gordion
248.text: "As you know, I was there in the palace when it happened. And believe me, I have some questions of my own."

249.speaker: Titus Gordion
249.text: "Should everyone who was present that night be considered a suspect?"

250.speaker: Player_Romus
250.text: "Almost everyone. Leave my butler out of it."

251.speaker: Player_Romus
251.text: "Yes. Hugo, the Grand Wiseman, my mother, Lucita Azaro. And Pabel, too."

252.speaker: Narrator
252.text: The others filed out of the room. Hugo stayed behind.

255.speaker: Titus Gordion
255.text: "Consider it handled. Expect an update soon along with the progress on Su Omina."

261.speaker: Player_Romus
261.text: "I don't have anything against Rico personally. But Wehlen needs a scapegoat."

262.speaker: Player_Romus
262.text: "Whether or not Su Omina was involved in Zille, I want Rico to rein them in."

263.speaker: Hugo Toras
263.text: "Come to Iza, Romus. Speak to your cousin. You're long overdue."

265.speaker: Narrator
265.text: Without waiting for an answer, he left.

266.speaker: Player_Romus
266.text: "You were right. It's about time I visited Rico in Iza."

269.speaker: Narrator
269.text: Hugo was quiet for a moment, then looked me in the eyes.

270.speaker: Narrator
270.text: My uncle looked me in the eyes.

271.speaker: Narrator
271.text: He turned and left the room.

273.speaker: Player_Romus
273.text: "My days with that group are long over. We have to make it clear that they don't represent the throne."

274.speaker: Player_Romus
274.text: "I know Su Omina. They would never commit such a reprehensible act."

278.speaker: Lucita Azaro
278.text: "The continued involvement of one Rico Toras would suggest otherwise."

279.speaker: Hugo Toras
279.text: "I told you, Duchess Azaro, I've already spoken to Rico. He had absolutely nothing to do with what happened."

280.speaker: Player_Romus
280.text: "What evidence are they basing this on? Anyone can scream 'For the King.'"

281.speaker: Lucita Azaro
281.text: "They've grown more extreme since your day. Rico Toras would know."

283.speaker: Player_Romus
283.text: "The views of those extremists do not represent those of the throne. We have to make that clear."

284.speaker: Player_Romus
284.text: "What exactly has your son Rico been up to in Iza, Your Grace?"

285.speaker: Lucita Azaro
285.text: "Unclear. This is all they've told us. The Duke of Iza might be able to clarify the situation."

286.speaker: Hugo Toras
286.text: "I've already spoken to Rico. He had absolutely nothing to do with what happened."

287.speaker: Player_Romus
287.text: "Why was I not included in this conversation?"

288.speaker: Hugo Toras
288.text: "Because it was superfluous. Su Omina promotes Rizian values. Terrorism is not part of their mission."

289.speaker: Player_Romus
289.text: "What were Su Omina's activities like in the months leading up to the attack?"

290.speaker: Lucita Azaro
290.text: "Nothing out of the ordinary. A few marches and a rally held at the Duke of Iza's mansion in protest of the new Dastnurist Grandsanctuary expansion."

294.speaker: Lucita Azaro
294.text: "Nothing out of the ordinary. A few marches."

295.speaker: Hugo Toras
295.text: "All peaceful events held to promote Rizian values. Su Omina is not and has never been a violent organization."

296.speaker: Player_Romus
296.text: "I believe him. This has Wehlen's fingerprints all over it."

297.speaker: Player_Romus
297.text: "How can you trust him? Of course he wouldn't admit to being involved."

298.speaker: Hugo Toras
298.text: "I trust him because I trust the organization. Su Omina promotes Rizian values. Its aims are peaceful."

299.speaker: Hugo Toras
299.text: "A sight more likely than a peaceful group of Rizians suddenly taking up bomb making."

300.speaker: Lucita Azaro
300.text: "I should clarify, the group's official activities have never been violent. But individual members have printed leaflets calling for a more... 'creative' solution to the Wehzek problem."

304.speaker: Player_Romus
304.text: "You know I will always support Su Omina. If I condemn them, I'm condemning myself."

312.speaker: Player_Romus
312.text: "I hate to disappoint both of you, but our treasury can't afford either investigation."

315.speaker: Titus Gordion
315.text: "Rest assured this will not affect my own commitment to your family's security, Your Majesty."

322.speaker: Hugo Toras
322.text: "And I'm expecting tact and discretion, needless to say."

323.speaker: Player_Romus
323.text: "Don't be afraid to get your hands dirty, Titus."

324.speaker: Player_Romus
324.text: "As am I. House Toras must appear clean in all this."

325.speaker: Player_Romus
325.text: "Stop hassling my guard. My trust in Titus should be enough reassurance for you both."

326.speaker: Narrator
326.text: Lucita and Titus looked at each other.

327.speaker: Lucita Azaro
327.text: "I see, Your Majesty. Thank you for considering my proposal nonetheless."

328.speaker: Titus Gordion
328.text: "Rest assured I remain as devoted to your security as ever, Your Majesty."

329.speaker: Hugo Toras
329.text: "Saving money is always prudent. We don't know what lies ahead."

330.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
330.text: "You will, however, still have to draft a public response to Wehlen's statement."

332.speaker: Player_Romus
332.text: "I won't dignify their accusations with a reply."

334.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
334.text: "The international community will be anticipating it, Your Majesty. A lack of a response is also a response."

338.speaker: Hugo Toras
338.text: "The group is unfairly maligned. If more people actually attended their events, they'd see."

339.speaker: Hugo Toras
339.text: "That's the message the public needs to hear."

340.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
340.text: "There's still the matter of the King's public response."

341.speaker: Hugo Toras
341.text: "Would it? Or would it cast unnecessary suspicions on the royal family?"

342.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
342.text: "If you wanted to go further, you could emphasize that Su Omina is a 'lone wolf' that does not represent the views of the crown."

346.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
346.text: "I suggest you tell the truth. You take Wehlen's intelligence seriously and will be conducting your own investigation into the suspected perpetrators."

347.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
347.text: "I trust you to make the diplomatically correct choice, Your Majesty."

348.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
348.text: "Emphasizing, of course, that Su Omina is a 'lone wolf' that does not represent the views of the crown."

350.speaker: Hugo Toras
350.text: "Or express your confidence that the group is innocent. Which it is."

351.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
351.text: "I suggest a boilerplate statement, expressing Rizia's condolences for the Wehzek victims and our wishes that the perpetrators be brought to justice."

352.speaker: Player_Romus
352.text: "Then help me out. What do I say?"

353.speaker: Player_Romus
353.text: "All right. I'll draft the statement after this meeting."

355.speaker: Hugo Toras
355.text: "Or express your confidence that the group is innocent. Which it is."

356.speaker: Hugo Toras
356.text: "That's the message the public needs to hear."

358.speaker: Hugo Toras
358.text: "It would do the group no favors to have an old man like me in the spotlight."

359.speaker: Hugo Toras
359.text: "They need youth, vitality. They are the future of Rizia, after all."

367.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
367.text: "I would also advise you to include an apology for your words in Zille."

368.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
368.text: "I would advise you not to confirm or deny Su Omina's guilt at this time. Not until more is known."

369.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
369.text: "I find it unwise to confirm or deny Su Omina's innocence before more information is known. But I'll leave it to you, Your Majesty."

373.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
373.text: "And, well, do consider including an apology for your speech in Zille."

375.speaker: Narrator
375.text: I picked up a pen and began drafting my response to Wehlen.

379.speaker: Narrator
379.text: Everyone automatically fell silent as Lucita strode through the room.

380.speaker: Narrator
380.text: She was dressed in her army major's blazer, with two stars prominently displayed above her right breast pocket.

384.speaker: Narrator
384.text: Now that crisis had struck, her entire bearing had changed. She had a commanding air about her that recalled her father.

385.speaker: Narrator
385.text: Now that crisis had struck, her entire bearing had changed. She had a commanding air about her.

389.speaker: Narrator
389.text: Lucita greeted Vina with an impatient half-bow.

390.speaker: Lucita Azaro
390.text: "A pleasure as usual, Your Highness. Now, let's not waste any more time."

396.speaker: Player_Romus
396.text: "I want to find out exactly how my father died."

399.speaker: Narrator
399.text: She gave me a puzzled look.

400.speaker: Lucita Azaro
400.text: "Very well, Your Majesty. I hope you know you can come to me with any request. Or anything that's on your mind at all."

402.speaker: Lucita Azaro
402.text: "It was a heart attack. He was an old man."

406.speaker: Player_Romus
406.text: "I have reason to believe the causes were less than natural."

407.speaker: Player_Romus
407.text: "Don't question me. Just open an investigation. Discreetly."

409.speaker: Lucita Azaro
409.text: "It won't be easy with the Golden Guard around, but I can commission a small team."

411.speaker: Lucita Azaro
411.text: "Am I to assume everyone who was in the Palace the day of his death is a suspect?"

412.speaker: Player_Romus
412.text: "Almost everyone. Leave my butler out of it."

413.speaker: Player_Romus
413.text: "Yes. Titus, Hugo, my mother and the Grand Wiseman. And Pabel, too."

417.speaker: Lucita Azaro
417.text: "I appreciate your trust in me. Consider it handled."

422.speaker: Vina Toras
422.text: "Queen Lyza always said monarchy was incompatible with nationalism. 'The crown knows no borders.'"

424.speaker: Player_Romus
424.text: "Of course they would say that. It's clear that President Smolak was behind this."

426.speaker: Hugo Toras
426.text: "Besides, I've already spoken to Rico. He had absolutely nothing to do with what happened."

430.speaker: Player_Romus
430.text: "Exactly. I believe that there's reason to suspect that the late king died under questionable circumstances. And I need you to dig up everything there is to know about it."

431.speaker: Narrator
431.text: Eyes wide, Titus hushed his voice, ensuring our conversation was confidential.

432.speaker: Titus Gordion
432.text: "If there's evidence of wrongdoing, should we regard everyone in the palace at the time as a potential suspect?"

433.speaker: Titus Gordion
433.text: "You're not the only one troubled by your father's untimely death. As someone present on that fateful night, it's reassuring to know you've taken an interest."

434.speaker: Titus Gordion
434.text: "In the event of incriminating evidence, do we need to treat anyone who was in the palace as a potential suspect?"

436.speaker: Player_Romus
436.text: "I'd like to know exactly how my father died. I have reason to believe that his death was no accident."

437.speaker: Player_Romus
437.text: "I'd like you to initiate a murder inquiry, with a specific focus on the circumstances surrounding my father's demise."

438.speaker: Player_Romus
438.text: "I believe that there's reason to suspect that the late king died under questionable circumstances. And I need you to dig up everything there is to know about it."

439.speaker: Titus Gordion
439.text: "In any case, expect an update soon on the progress on Su Omina."

441.speaker: Hugo Toras
441.text: "Captain Gordion. I am all for the expansion of the Golden Guard, but not if you insist on using it to chase a dead end."

442.speaker: Lucita Azaro
442.text: "Perhaps so, Captain Gordion, but the attack took place in Wehlen. Any resources that go towards investigating it should be allocated there, not within Rizia."

444.speaker: Player_Romus
444.text: "The crown will not provide further assistance."

446.speaker: Titus Gordion
446.text: "Your Majesty, you recently conveyed your wish to strengthen our ranks and allow us to assume additional duties. This incident would serve as an excellent opportunity to demonstrate our capabilities."

450.speaker: Lucita Azaro
450.text: "I'm sorry, but why wasn't I privy to this discussion?"

451.speaker: Lucita Azaro
451.text: "The expansion of the Golden Guard is a security-related issue, which, as Councilor of War and Internal Security, falls under my purview."

452.speaker: Player_Romus
452.text: "Our discussion wasn't intentionally concealed from you, nor was it pre-planned. Forgive me for not informing you sooner."

453.speaker: Player_Romus
453.text: "It's not your place to question whom I talk to and when. If there's information worth knowing, I'll ensure it's shared when I deem it appropriate."

455.speaker: Player_Romus
455.text: "Titus and I spoke about it recently. I've been meaning to bring it up with you."

462.speaker: Titus Gordion
462.text: "I must say... last we spoke, You Majesty, I was under the impression that the Golden Guard had your full support."

463.speaker: Titus Gordion
463.text: "Our conversation left me with quite optimistic expectations, and it's disappointing that they won't be coming to fruition."

464.speaker: Titus Gordion
464.text: "I hope this isn't indicative of future commitments."

465.speaker: Player_Romus
465.text: "Enough with your baseless insinuations. Circumstances change, and I must make decisions in the best interests of Rizia, not those of the Golden Guard."

466.speaker: Player_Romus
466.text: "I respect you as my guardsman, Captain, but this is an internationally sensitive incident. We've got to treat it with the seriousness it deserves."

467.speaker: Player_Romus
467.text: "Sometimes even the best-laid plans can take unexpected turns. I'll try to make it up to you."

468.speaker: Player_Romus
468.text: "And you'll continue to have my full support. I simply agree with Duchess Azaro on the course of how this investigation should proceed."

473.speaker: Titus Gordion
473.text: "However, I must admit my disappointment, considering your previous expression of full support for the Golden Guard."

474.speaker: Player_Romus
474.text: "My support for the Golden Guard remains as steadfast as ever, and your insinuations are unfounded. Circumstances change, and decisions must be made in the best interest of Rizia."

475.speaker: Player_Romus
475.text: "And I must admit my disappointment in you, Captain. You, of all people, should know your place and respect the decisions made for the greater good of Rizia."

476.speaker: Player_Romus
476.text: "Life has a way of throwing surprises into our best-laid plans. I'll try to make it up to you."

477.speaker: Player_Romus
477.text: "And you'll continue to have my full support. It's just that I share Duchess Azaro's perspective on the way this investigation ought to move forward."

482.speaker: Lucita Azaro
482.text: "Very well. But in the future, please include me in confidential internal security meetings. I'd appreciate being a part of the conversation."

483.speaker: Player_Romus
483.text: "You'll be included in such meetings if I deem it necessary."

485.speaker: Player_Romus
485.text: "Yes. Next time I'll be sure you're included. This was an isolated incident."

488.speaker: Lucita Azaro
488.text: "Thank you, Your Majesty. In any case..."

489.speaker: Narrator
489.text: Lucita let out a sigh of exasperation.

494.speaker: Lucita Azaro
494.text: "What you call 'red tape,' I call accountability. You are asking for permission to act outside the law."

495.speaker: Titus Gordion
495.text: "I am asking for permission to become a more agile, flexible arm of the law than any division currently in operation. This will benefit us both."

496.speaker: Titus Gordion
496.text: "With a full-fledged division under my command, I could also easily send a team to Iza to confirm or rule out Su Omina's involvement in what happened."

497.speaker: Lucita Azaro
497.text: "All well and good, Your Majesty, but the fact remains that national security is not Captain Gordion's area of expertise."

498.speaker: Lucita Azaro
498.text: "Now that the subject has been broached, I will gently point out that national security is not Captain Gordion's area of expertise."

499.speaker: Titus Gordion
499.text: "Your Majesty, you recently conveyed your apprehension over re-expanding the Golden Guard's ranks and duties. But this incident would serve as an excellent opportunity for us to demonstrate our capabilities."

variablesModified.value: "Under the reign of King Romus Toras, the Golden Guard was enlarged into a division-sized unit and given expanded duties."
